title: Reference
description: A source that was trusted, what it holds, and when it was read (references/<id>.yaml). Necessary, not sufficient: cross-file rules (id = filename, provenance, supersede pairs, one active fact per subject, credential grep) live in scripts/check-cards.sh.

format.description: Major version of the memory format (docs/memory-format.md). A reader accepts a card whose major it knows.

visibility.description: Who may see this card: the owner only; people or agents the owner grants; anyone.
